text.description_html:
PDQ 6300 Series 36 Inch Door Concealed Vertical Rod Exit Device

The PDQ 6300 Series offers superior durability and security in commercial applications while providing compliance with life safety and fire code requirements. This Concealed Vertical Rod Exit Device For 36 Inch Doors is non-handed.

Fasteners are furnished for both wood and metal door applications. Sex nuts are optional. These exit devices are listed by U.L./U.L.C. and comply with U.L. 10C and UL 305 Panic .

Meets requirements of the Buy American Act. ADA compliant and ICC/ANSI 117.1 for accessible and usable buildings.

Features and Specifications for the PDQ 6300C Vertical Rod Exit Device:

  • Exit Only
  • Includes Optional Cylinder Dogging Best SFIC 7 Pin Housing less Core
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Chassis: Corrosion resistant plated steel.
  • Rail: Extruded aluminum.
  • Touch Pad: Stainless steel
  • Top Latch Bolt: Stainless Steel 3/4" Toggle
  • Bottom Latch Bolt: 5/8" Travel Drop Bolt
  • Projection: 3-1/8" projection
  • Hand: Device is non-handed
  • Dogging: No dogging on fire labeled devices.
  • Application: Concealed Vertical Rod (7'0" tall door standard)
  • Stile Width: 3.5" Minimum
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4"- 2"
  • Door Width: Standard 3'0" door maximum
  • Door Height: Standard Up to 7' High Door.
  • Certifications: U.L./U.L.C. listed for "Panic", "Fire Exit Hardware" labeled for up to 1-1/2 hour for 3'0" x 7'0" maximum single, 6'0" x 7'0" maximum pairs / Complies with U.L. 10C and UBC 7.2 (1997)
